text:
Drake Batherson has nine goals in 19 games and points in a run of recent games, and he's been one of the reasons Ottawa keeps winning the chance battle through injuries to William Eklund and others. He's on the line with Shane Pinto and Philip Tomasino in the latest Senators lines posted by Coming Down the Pipe.

The finishing is high (22%), though not far from his 20% last season, so the drop-off may be smaller than the flag suggests. Last season's chances were better than his goals, by Evolving-Hockey's count. This season it's the other way around, a little.

He's a fourth-round pick turned 33-goal scorer, with most of his value last season coming on the power play. Our win probability has his goals adding more wins than all but 38 skaters. He told TSN he doesn't want to rely on the last game. Our range: 24 to 39 goals.
